basic_info.description: Blending timeless Victorian charm w/ contemporary sophistication, this fully remodeled 1906 residence offers 1,594 sqft of thoughtfully designed living space. At its heart, the entertainer's kitchen is a showpiece, featuring quartz countertops, a striking tile backsplash, & premium stainless steel appliances. With 3 bright bedrooms & two & a half updated bathrooms, this home is designed for both comfort & style. The sunlit primary suite enjoys direct access to the private west-facing patio & lush garden, featuring a Trex flooring deck. A separate hallway entry also provides seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The bathrooms have been tastefully updated, with the primary bath now featuring an elegant marble backsplash. The backyard has been thoughtfully landscaped for child play, gardening & entertaining, with lush plantings including lemon trees, jasmine, bougainvillea, lily of the Nile, and hedging that creates a secluded retreat. Wine enthusiasts will appreciate the custom 200-bottle solid wood wall-mounted wine cellar shelving in the basement. Perfectly positioned in the heart of Bernal Heights, just two blocks from Cortland Avenue's vibrant shops and cafs, this home offers easy access to Holly Park, Bernal Hill, and major commuter routes.
